changelog: CARD PILES YOU CAN LOOK AT. Three buttons in battle — Draw, Discard, and Exhaust (which appears once something has been exhausted). The draw pile shows what is still to come, sorted by name, never the order it will arrive in; discard and exhaust list every card in the order it went in. Every upgrade now states what it actually does — all 56 cards from the new set were printing their un-upgraded rules, and several upgrades did nothing at all. Three new commander medals: Overstrength (Warlord), Charge Doctrine (Nomad) and Load Balancing (Engineer). Upgraded Build cards can now be raised beside any unit or building you own, which their text always promised and the game never allowed. Plus a long list of fixes: Overstrength was unusable from the hand, Load Balancing was quietly eating a third of the damage it claims only to spread, free cards showed full price and greyed themselves out, and the raider announced itself before you could see it. Card faces are now composited at runtime, which took 31.8 MB off the download.
